name: piataro
description: PiațăRo. backend/ and frontend/ are two npm projects with their own lockfiles; this root holds the house-style tools, and its scripts call into both.

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:conventions && npm test
scripts.check:fast: npm --prefix backend run check:fast && npm --prefix frontend run check:fast && node scripts/check-fast.mjs
scripts.check:conventions: npm --prefix backend run knip && npm --prefix frontend run knip && depcruise backend/app/src backend/core/src frontend/src && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-base-ui.mjs --warn-only && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-structure.mjs --warn-only
